description: This file defines MainActivity, an Android activity responsible for managing the main UI of the music player app, including binding to the music playback service, setting up bottom navigation, and handling fragment transactions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Primary activity managing the app's main UI, services, and navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, binds to the music service, and sets up navigation and mini-player.

methods.name: setupNavigation
methods.description: Configures bottom navigation item selection to load corresponding fragments.

methods.name: setupMiniPlayer
methods.description: Sets up click listeners for mini-player controls.

methods.name: loadFragment
methods.description: Replaces the current fragment with the specified one.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Handles cleanup by unbinding from the service.
